artifact_observations.reasoning: Large, opaque white patches appear to be floating on or peeling off the surface. They lack the translucency of cheese or the texture of icing, resembling melted plastic or AI-generated noise.

The cloth background has a slightly smudged, painterly quality typical of AI generation, though less severe than the subject defects.
